units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 2:3:3">Y. Gitt. II, 44ᵇ</cite> <he>רוֹשֵׁם לפניהן בדיו וכ׳</he> one may draw (the signatures of illiterate witnesses) for them with ink, and they write them over with red paint (contrad. to <he>קרע</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 2:3:3">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 12:4:3">Y. Sabb. XII, 13ᵈ</cite> <he>הרושם … כתבנית וכ׳</he> if one draws on a skin figures like writing.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:4">Sabb. XII, 4</cite> <he>ובכל דבר שהוא רוֹשֵׁם</he> and with any material which marks; <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 2:3">Gitt. II, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Gittin 19a">19ᵃ</cite>), v. <cite ref="S00937"><he>קַיָּימָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 10:3">Ḥull. X, 3</cite> <he>צריך שיִרְשׁוֹם</he> he must mark the animal. Tanḥ. Tsav 5 <he>האדם … רושם עליו מיתה וכ׳</he> when a man sins, the Lord makes the mark of death upon him; if he repents, the writ is cancelled.

<cite ref="Shabbat 55a:6">Sabb. 55ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 9:4">Ez. IX, 4</cite>) <he>לך ורְשׁוֹם על וכ׳</he> go and mark the foreheads of the righteous with a sign of ink …, and the foreheads of the wicked with blood; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="T01073"><he>רָשׁוּם</he></cite>; f. <he>רְשׁוּמָה</he>; pl. <he>רְשׁוּמִים</he>, <he>רְשׁוּמִין</he>; <he>רְשׁוּמוֹת</he>. Y. Succ. IV, 54ᶜ top <he>עד שלא … היתה ר׳ ברקיע וכ׳</he> so long as the Israelites were not redeemed from Egypt, it (the sapphire brick) was placed as a mark in heaven &c.; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23">Lev. R. s. 23</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:8">Cant. R. to IV, 8</cite>.

Gen. R. s. 81 (ref. to Dan. X, 21) אם ר׳ למה אמת … למה ר׳ if marked (for future action), why real writing (decree), and if real writing why marked? (Answ.) ר׳ עד שלא נגזרה וכ׳ marked, before the divine decree was signed; Cant. R. to I, 9; a. e.—Esp. דורשי רשומות those who interpret the Law metaphorically.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 82a:5">B. Kam. 82ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 104b:15">Snh. 104ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 24a:15">Ber. 24ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. (ed. <he>חמורות</he>, v. Rashi a. l.).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9<sup>5</sup></cite> <he>וילדה בן מ׳ למה וכ׳</he> and she gave birth to a young that was marked; why? Because its mother was burnt (cauterized).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 78:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 41</cite> <he>המכות היו נִרְשָׁמוֹת בגופן</he> the plagues were engraven on their bodies (by ref. to Ps. l. c. 43).
